items.prompt: Two bundles of old letters tied with string lie on a desk under a lamp, one in pale envelopes and one in darker ones, with a few letters spilled between them; a fountain pen and a pair of round spectacles nearby.

alt.ru: Две пачки старых писем, перевязанные бечёвкой, на столе под лампой; между ними рассыпано несколько писем, рядом перьевая ручка и круглые очки.
alt.en: Two bundles of old letters tied with string on a desk under a lamp, a few spilled between them, a fountain pen and round spectacles nearby.
alt.pt: Dois maços de cartas antigas atados com cordel numa secretária sob o candeeiro, algumas espalhadas entre eles, uma caneta de tinta permanente e óculos redondos.
alt.es: Dos fajos de cartas antiguas atados con cordel sobre un escritorio bajo la lámpara, algunas esparcidas entre ellos, una pluma estilográfica y gafas redondas.
